benchmarks.name: Aider code editing (133 Exercism Python exercises, two attempts)
benchmarks.description: Aider's original code editing benchmark (superseded by the polyglot leaderboard): the model edits Python source files to complete 133 small Exercism exercises and must apply its own edits; score is pass_rate_2, the percent of exercises whose tests pass after at most two attempts (the second sees the test errors). Edit format per run in the note. Distinct from aider-polyglot (225 exercises, six languages).

benchmarks.name: WildBench v2 WB-Score (task macro)
benchmarks.metric: GPT-4o checklist score rescaled as (score-5)x2x10, macro-averaged over 5 task categories
benchmarks.description: WildBench v2 (1,024 challenging real-user tasks) scored by GPT-4o with per-task checklists; each 1-10 score is rescaled as (score-5)x2 and multiplied by 10 (0 = a 5/10 answer), then macro-averaged over Creative, Planning & Reasoning, Math & Data Analysis, Information/Advice seeking and Coding & Debugging ('WB_score.task_macro'). Signed raw units, not accuracy; fixed latent_scale 10 (ten WB-Score points). Not WB-Elo or pairwise reward.

ledger.quote: Owner rule (b), approved 2026-10-07: a vendor's own published score for its own model, from its announcement, system/model card or docs, may be recorded by hand one figure at a time with the exact URL, date and printed settings; other labs' cells excluded; rows labelled by: 'lab'; removed if the vendor objects. The Nova Premier report carries no open licence. Terms: Amazon Conditions of Use, linked from the amazon.science footer.

ledger.quote: Owner rule (b), approved 2026-10-07: a vendor's own published score for its own model may be recorded by hand one figure at a time with exact URL, date and printed settings; other labs' cells excluded; rows labelled by: 'lab'.
